from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyRevenueReport(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial revenue data from a single company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The legal name of the company as stated in the filing")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period covered by the report (e.g., quarter ended)")
    revenue_line_item: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item label for revenue in the document (e.g., 'Net Sales', 'Total Revenue')")
    reported_revenue_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of revenue found in the text")
    reported_unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale stated in the document header (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_reports: list[CompanyRevenueReport]
